_comment: Labelled retrieval questions for the recall gate (phase 15).
Ground truth is a CHAPTER, not a chunk id. Chunk ids are assigned in file
order by scripts/fetch_corpus.py, so they change whenever the chunker or the
upstream extraction changes -- and a gate keyed on them would go red on every
corpus regeneration for reasons unrelated to retrieval quality. A gate that
cries wolf gets deleted, so this one is labelled at a granularity that
These are authored questions, not invented data: the corpus is FAO's and
untouched. This is the same kind of artefact as phase 12's golden cases -- a
human saying what a right answer looks like.
'chapters' lists every chapter that would be an acceptable hit. Several
questions legitimately have two, because FAO-56 splits single/dual crop

questions.query: readily available water RAW and the management allowed depletion fraction p
questions.why: The irrigation trigger this system computes. Chapter 8 defines RAW = p x TAW.

questions.query: total available water from field capacity wilting point and rooting depth
questions.why: TAW is the ceiling the running water balance is clamped to.

questions.query: crop coefficient Kc mid-season stage for vines and fruit trees
questions.why: Deps.kc's source. The passage explains it; Deps still supplies the number.

questions.query: crop evapotranspiration ETc equals ETo multiplied by the crop coefficient
FAO Penman-Monteith equation for reference evapotranspiration ETo
questions.why: Where the ET0 column in the weather feed comes from.

questions.query: wind speed measurement height two metres and adjustment for evapotranspiration
questions.why: The spray gate reasons about wind; the ETo calculation depends on it.

questions.query: dew point temperature relative humidity and vapour pressure deficit
questions.why: Delta-T is reconstructed from temperature and wet bulb; same chapter.

questions.query: water stress coefficient Ks when root zone depletion exceeds RAW
questions.why: What happens past the trigger the advisory recommends acting on.

questions.query: irrigation scheduling to avoid crop water stress and depth of water to apply
questions.why: The advisory's recommended_depth_mm, in the document's own terms.

questions.query: evaporation from bare soil after a wetting event and the evaporation coefficient Ke
questions.why: The dual-coefficient half this system deliberately does not model.

questions.query: how much rainfall infiltrates the root zone and how much is lost to runoff
crop growth stages initial development mid-season and late season lengths
questions.why: Which Kc applies when -- the config decision a grower actually makes.
